solution:
The correct answer is __**a-iii,b-i,c-ii**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• (a) Nationalisation of 14 banks → 1969 (iii)
 
 
• The **nationalisation of 14 banks** happened in **1969** under the leadership of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
 
 
• (b) Dr. Manmohan Singh appointed the Governor of RBI → 1982 (i)
 
 
• Dr. **Manmohan Singh** was appointed the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in **1982**.
 
 
 
• (c) Demonetisation of Rs. 10,000 bank notes → 1978 (ii)
 
 
• The **demonetisation of Rs. 10,000 bank notes** happened in **1978**.
 
 
 
• So, the correct match is:
 
 
• a-iii, b-i, c-ii.
